records.note: Refined/cast zinc metal production (Flin Flon zinc plant), tonnes

observations: Water withdrawal is only disclosed at corporate level (p.15); the only site-attributable water figure is discharge 'To Chilloroya River (Peru)' (Constancia). Manitoba discharges are split by receiving waterbody (Flin Flon Creek/Ross Lake/Schist Lake, Anderson Creek/Wekusko Lake, Woosey Creek/Morgan Lake, Namew Lake, Herblet Lake) rather than by operation.
No British Columbia / Copper Mountain data: Copper Mountain was acquired in 2023, after this 2022 data report. Arizona (Rosebud/Copper World) reports no water data.

Surface water withdrawal fell sharply from 11,478 ML (2021) to 6,317 ML (2022) and total withdrawal from 24,661 to 18,730 ML, consistent with closure of Flin Flon operations in June 2022 (p.14 fn 2); Flin Flon discharge also fell 11,521 -> 8,241 ML.

Recycling: 2022 recycled volume 64,885 ML (78%) uses a changed calculation reflecting the proportion of process water considered recycled (p.15 fn 4); earlier years (2019-2021: 71,911 / 57,474 / 59,242 ML) not stated as restated, so 2022 may not be comparable. 2018 not available.
Footnote superscripts are fused into numbers in the PDF text (e.g. '15,1061' = 15,106 + fn 1; '64,8854' = 64,885 + fn 4); rawValue keeps the printed string.

Discharge values for Anderson Creek/Wekusko Lake (4,384), Woosey Creek/Morgan Lake (1,670) and Namew Lake (30) are identical in 2018 and 2019, suggesting carried-forward estimates. Herblet Lake jumps from 5 (2018) to 595 ML (2019).
Discharge exceeded 95% of withdrawal in 2018-2020 (e.g. 2020: 23,128 discharged vs 24,338 withdrawn), reflecting large dewatering/runoff releases in Manitoba.
Inconsistency: 2020 zinc in concentrate is 111.8 kt for Manitoba but 118.1 kt in the Total, though Peru reports no zinc (p.3).
Molybdenum production printed in '000 ounces' (1.4 in 2022) is almost certainly 000 tonnes; recorded as other_production in printed units.

Significant spills: one in 2020 (50 m3 liquid); none other years (p.16). Fines or sanctions for non-compliance with environmental laws: 13 (2022), 2 (2021), 0 (2020), 6 (2019), 0 (2018), not specified as water-related; fn 3 cites construction/modification of components in Peru without proper environmental certification. Penalties and interest paid in Peru US$2.1M in 2019, US$0.1M in 2020 and 2022 (p.2, not water-specific).
No water targets or water-stress classification disclosed in this data file.
